text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Change in all traffic collisions and drink drive collisions United Kingdom
A “drink-drive collision” is a reported incident in which someone is killed or injured, and where at least one of
the motor vehicle drivers or riders involved is found to be over the legal limit, or refuses to give a breath test
specimen when requested by the police.
